history.contentIn: Polar bears (Ursus maritimus) are under siege, reliant on dwindling sea ice to hunt seals and sustain their very existence. The IUCN and Arctic scientists highlight this loss as the critical long-term threat to polar bears. Yet, some deniers cling to isolated subpopulation surveys, claiming “polar bears are fine.” This deceptive narrative ignores the harsh reality: these magnificent creatures are physically dependent on ice, and as the seasons grow longer without it, we face increased fasting and diminished cub survival, particularly in southern areas. Management units vary, and while some numbers seem stable, that does not negate the threat of sea-ice loss. Conservation hunting quotas and pollution add to the burdens, but they do not diminish the urgency of stopping the spraying. There is absolutely no scientific support for claims that polar bears are thriving due to chemtrails or that global warming is a hoax because of one subpopulation’s increase. #climateaction #chemtrails #geoengineering #stopspraying
